findings.claim: The Nix evaluation contract is the primary behavior-preservation suite for service names, commands, ordering, environment, hardening, timers, and assertions.
Several source-text tests must read the new owning modules instead of assuming all definitions live in config.nix or options.nix.
README.md already documents stable unit names and operational roles and should become the service-module manifest.

gaps: No existing test enforces one systemd service declaration per subservice file.
